summary: Stale test, not a code defect. permodel-key-allowlist.test.cjs asserts the hand-maintained _MODEL_WIDE_KEYS allowlist that MPI-336 replaced with a scope-derived modelWide flag (projectService.js:209-213). Live sidecar from the MPI-346 app run proves the runtime path is correct. Rewrite or delete; never satisfy it by re-adding keys to the Set.

Also cleared the other 6 standing failures: optional-media-placeholder (MPI-272 un-staged placeholder.png/ltx_silence.wav), resolve-model-deps (LTX_t2v.json vs lowercase ltx_t2v.json) and remoteProxy x4 (the MPI-175 module split left remotePodState singleton leaking between tests). Suite is 275/275, zero failures - no known-failing baseline remains.
